# 1 Samuel Chapter 29 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 29

---

### Verse 1
- **EMET:** "And-gathered [the]-Philistines all their-camps to-Aphek, and-Israel [was]-encamping by-the-spring which [is]-in-Jezreel."
- **LOGOS:** "Now the Philistines gathered all their armies at Aphek, and the Israelites were encamped by the spring that is in Jezreel."
- **PNEUMA:** "The Philistines assembled their entire army at Aphek, while the Israelites camped by the spring at Jezreel."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-[the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines [were]-passing-on by-hundreds and-by-thousands, and-David and-his-men [were]-passing-on in-the-rear with-Achish."
- **LOGOS:** "And the lords of the Philistines were passing on by hundreds and by thousands, and David and his men were passing on in the rear with Achish."
- **PNEUMA:** "As the Philistine rulers marched past with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 4
- **EMET:** "And-were-angry with-him [the]-commanders of-[the]-Philistines. And-said to-him [the]-commanders of-[the]-Philistines, "Send-back the-man, and-let-him-..."
- **LOGOS:** "But the commanders of the Philistines were angry with him. And the commanders said to him, "Send the man back, that he may return to the place that yo..."
- **PNEUMA:** "But the Philistine commanders were furious with Achish. "Send him back!" they said. "He must return to the town you gave him. He is not going into bat..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 5
- **EMET:** "Is-not this David of-whom they-sing in-the-dances, saying, 'Saul has-struck his-thousands, and-David his-ten-thousands'?""
- **LOGOS:** "Is not this David, of whom they sing to one another in dances, 'Saul has struck his thousands, and David his ten thousands'?""
- **PNEUMA:** "Isn't this the David they sing about in their dances: 'Saul has killed his thousands, and David his tens of thousands'?""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "And-called Achish David and-said to-him, "[As]-YHWH lives, indeed you [are]-upright, and-good in-my-eyes [is]-your-going-out and-your-coming-in with-m..."
- **LOGOS:** "Then Achish called David and said to him, "As the LORD lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army has bee..."
- **PNEUMA:** "So Achish called David in and said, "As surely as the LORD lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you go with me in the campaig..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-now return and-go in-peace, and-you-will-not do evil in-[the]-eyes of-[the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines.""
- **LOGOS:** "So turn back now and go in peace, that you may not displease the lords of the Philistines.""
- **PNEUMA:** "So go back in peace. Don't do anything to displease the Philistine rulers.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 9
- **EMET:** "And-answered Achish and-said to-David, "I-know that you [are]-good in-my-eyes, like-an-angel of-God. But [the]-commanders of-[the]-Philistines have-sa..."
- **LOGOS:** "And Achish answered David and said, "I know that you are as blameless in my sight as an angel of God. Nevertheless, the commanders of the Philistines ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Achish answered, "I know that you've been as reliable as an angel of God in my sight. But the Philistine commanders have insisted, 'He must not go wit..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-now rise-early in-the-morning, and-[the]-servants of-your-lord who came with-you — and-rise-early in-the-morning, and-when-there-is-light for-you,..."
- **LOGOS:** "Now then rise early in the morning, you and the servants of your lord who came with you, and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light..."
- **PNEUMA:** "So get up early tomorrow morning — you and your master's servants who came with you — and leave as soon as it is light.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
